title: Model system v1
description: config/model/systems/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F1): one of the managed systems of the engineering life cycle, with the ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288/12207 processes and SWEBOK v4 areas it covers, its owner and its own measure.

id.description: The system id, equal to the file name.

group.description: D-330: the group of systems it belongs to, after ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288's split: management (the work and its direction: intent, work, decisions, measurement; its standard is docs/padrao/METODO.md) or engineering (every other system; its standard is the rule catalog of config/standard/rules).

processes.description: The 15288/12207 processes and SWEBOK areas it covers.

owner.description: Who owns the system: one of the three domains of AGENTS.md (capacity, efficiency, administration) or Daniel.

measure.description: The system's own measure, in one sentence.
